purpose: Decide whether the preregistered ten-system same-object identifiability sample remains attainable from the audited public-data universe without replacing failed gates, counting proxy observables, or selecting another one-off target.
evidence_classes: the 15-system same-object gap ledger and its structural ceiling
the all-14 SLACS-KCWI primary-source and public-product screen
the frozen J0946, ESO 325-G004, and J1402 external-candidate dispositions
the active but outcome-unseen RX J2129 strict-observable production gates

hard_shortfall_gate.inventory_boundary: at least 30 unique BCG hosts source-screened
hard_shortfall_gate.replacement_evidence: three consecutively completed residual-blind external candidates with zero promotion
hard_shortfall_gate.bulk_sample_evidence: all 14 SLACS-KCWI systems screened and zero public numerical kinematic maps identified
hard_shortfall_gate.mathematical_deficit: at least seven genuinely new rank-three systems remain necessary even if every existing ceiling system were repaired
hard_shortfall_gate.decision: all five conditions establish a hard public-data identifiability shortfall for the ten-system sample

RXJ2129_branches.if_strict_ready: retain RX J2129 only as a single-system pipeline/identifiability demonstration; it cannot authorize population cross-validation or a universal latent response
RXJ2129_branches.if_not_strict_ready: retain RX J2129 as structural-only and perform no dynamical or Weyl response reconstruction
RXJ2129_branches.unchanged_in_both_branches: the audited public-data universe cannot supply ten systems, R2 population cross-validation is empirically unidentifiable, and no unification or new-force-law claim is authorized

forbidden_rescues: select a fourth one-off external target after inspecting J1402
count repeated images at one radius as independent Weyl modes
use GR-fit mass, slope, kappa, or residual covariance as theory-neutral response data
extend a dynamics validity range after inspecting lens overlap
weaken any failed calibration, covariance, predictive, or coherent-residual gate
call a one-system method demonstration population cross-validation
